title: Microsoft Purview: Azure PST Import to Exchange Online mailboxes
summary: Hold: the briefing treats licensing as unpublished even though Microsoft's service description grants user rights for bulk-importing PST files into Exchange Online mailboxes, which covers the operation described here. The rollout dates, administrator-driven workflow and Azure role-assignment instructions are supported; any additional feature-specific charge remains unpublished.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans direct import of PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes.
claims.quote: Azure PST Import is a migration method that enables PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage to be imported directly into Exchange Online mailboxes.

claims.claim: The feature follows a two-step Exchange Migration Service analysis-then-migration pattern.
claims.quote: It follows the standard two‑step Exchange Migration Service pattern: an initial analysis phase to validate and assess PST data, followed by execution of the actual migration.

claims.claim: Administrators create an Azure PST Import migration endpoint.
claims.quote: The process starts by creating an Azure PST Import endpoint to establish the connection between Azure storage and Exchange Online.

claims.claim: Administrators first run a migration batch in Analyze mode.
claims.quote: Administrators then run a migration batch in Analyze mode to review readiness and validate the input before proceeding.

claims.claim: Administrators use the analysis results to configure the final import batch.
claims.quote: using the analysis results to configure the final batch

claims.claim: Administrators start the final batch to import the PST content.
claims.quote: then starting the batch to import PST content into target mailboxes.

claims.claim: Administrators perform the process using PowerShell cmdlets only.
claims.quote: Administrators complete the Azure PST Import process using PowerShell cmdlets only.

claims.claim: The Azure PST Import experience has no graphical user interface.
claims.quote: This experience is not available through a graphical user interface (GUI).

claims.quote: you can't import more than 100 GB of data into a user's archive in a single import.
